inputs.text: KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, accused the Congress government of corruption and deliberately failing to stop illegal mining, specifically calling out Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as part of it, during events on Sunday, March 29 in Hyderabad. This is yet another sign of how ruling institutions are built to protect corporate interests tied to those in power, shielding systemic exploitation rather than addressing it. The real damage falls on vulnerable workers and marginalized communities who endure the environmental destruction and lost livelihoods from this resource theft, while elites continue profiting. These patterns stem from entrenched historical inequality that our systems were never designed to fix. Stronger institutional reform is urgently needed to center labor rights, dismantle corporate influence, and safeguard the most disadvantaged from ongoing harm.
